# Vertex Web (فيرتكس ويب) — Web Design Studio, Tangier, Morocco

> Vertex Web is a web design and development studio based in Tangier, Morocco, founded by Mounir Boufrahi. It builds fast, mobile-first websites with WhatsApp ordering for restaurants, shops, real estate and service businesses across Morocco. Prices are fixed and published: landing page 900 MAD, business website 1,900 MAD, online store 4,900 MAD, cinematic website with ordering system 8,000 MAD. Delivery takes 7–14 days. Payment is 50% upfront and 50% after delivery. Basic hosting is included; the domain stays in the client's name (about 100–150 MAD/year).

## Services and prices (MAD, one-time)

- Landing page — 900 MAD, 7 days: one focused page for a campaign, a single service or a product launch, with WhatsApp call-to-action.
- Business website (site vitrine) — 1,900 MAD, 10 days: multi-page company website (home, about, services, work/prices, contact), Google Maps, WhatsApp and call buttons, technical SEO setup.
- Online store — 4,900 MAD, 14 days: full product catalogue, cart, WhatsApp ordering, cash on delivery and available online payment methods, no commission on sales.
- Cinematic website with ordering system — 8,000 MAD: scroll-controlled film scenes (canvas frame sequences up to 1920px), interactive menu/catalogue, cart with extras and delivery/pickup, orders delivered to the business's WhatsApp, Arabic + French + English.
- Redesign of an existing website is also available: full modern redesign, speed and mobile improvements, Google visibility fixes.

Full service comparison: https://vertex-web-tanger.onrender.com/services.html
- How we work (طريقتنا): same-day WhatsApp reply, a written fixed quote before any commitment, a model with the client's own data and a live preview link during the build, published delivery windows (7-21 days), 50% upfront / 50% after delivery, 30 days of free support, domain and files owned by the client — plus an honest list of what we don't do (no invented proof, no copied designs, no hidden prices, no impossible promises): https://vertex-web-tanger.onrender.com/process.html

- Post-launch follow-up & growth — monthly service after the free 30 days of support, at fixed published prices, in three scopes: (1) Follow-up — 199 MAD/month: uptime watch, content snapshots/backups, technical updates, small edits. (2) Growth — 490 MAD/month: everything in Follow-up plus monthly content updates, SEO/GEO visibility follow-up and a short monthly performance report. (3) Growth + Ads — 990 MAD/month: everything in Growth plus advertising campaign management (setup, copy, campaign landing pages, results tracking) run on the client's own ad account — the 990 MAD is a management fee only; ad spend is paid by the client directly and stays under their control. The follow-up runs Designjoy-style: one active request at a time from a simple queue, pause/resume anytime with the remaining days preserved, and a scope that resets monthly: https://vertex-web-tanger.onrender.com/suivi-croissance.html

## How working with Vertex Web works

1. The client sends the project idea on WhatsApp; Vertex Web replies the same day with precise questions and a written, no-obligation quote.
2. Design and build are custom (no templates), mobile-first.
3. The client reviews the live version and requests changes before launch.
4. Launch includes usage training and 30 days of free support (fixes, small edits, questions).

## Frequently asked questions

- How long does a website take? 7–14 days depending on type: landing page 7 days, business website 10 days, online store 14 days.
- Do you work outside Tangier? Yes — all of Morocco, remotely, by WhatsApp and calls, with the same organised delivery.
- How do I pay? 50% at the start, 50% after delivery — the balance is only due once the site is live and approved.
- Who owns the domain and the website? The client, fully. The domain is registered in the client's name; after full payment the site files and content belong to the client and can be moved to any hosting.
- Does the online store support WhatsApp and online payment? Yes — WhatsApp ordering is the base (it is what works best in Morocco), plus available online payment methods and cash on delivery.
- Can I manage the site myself afterwards? Yes — training is included at delivery, plus 30 days of free support.
- Who pays for domain and hosting? Basic hosting is included in the price. The domain is the client's and stays their property: about 100–150 MAD/year; Vertex Web helps choose and connect it.
- What if I have no texts or photos ready? Work can start with what exists; the delivery clock starts when the content is complete. Copywriting or photography are optional extras agreed separately in advance.
